root_cause: Portal-wide causal-impact enforcement started requiring a canonical BusinessInput acknowledgement for non-durable demo edits, while legacy causal regressions pinned a retired portal impact engine version.
prevention: Demo state changes must never invoke durable BusinessInput storage nor require an ACK.
Authenticated state writes must continue to require a verified BusinessInput ACK; missing token or ACK fails closed.
Keep causal propagation regressions aligned with the current ONE BRAIN all-pages version rather than weakening the runtime.

evidence.outcome: Demo-only non-durable branch restored and retired version expectation updated; production acceptance pending CI.
